scope: native no-failure coupon state, energy, impulse, and momentum arithmetic only

metadata.binary_storage_order: Julia column-major tensor [field_index, point_id, state_index]; field index varies fastest, then ascending point_id, then ascending state_index
metadata.energy_balance_semantics: diagnostic only: native staggered full-step energy minus accumulated half-step BC kinetic jumps; not qualified energy closure
metadata.actuator_work_semantics: surrogate only; excluded from the driver's energy residual

energy_qualification.note: The short post-unload dwell has not demonstrated stationarity; this reversible no-failure run does not qualify energy closure or physical fracture behavior.

interpretation_limits: NoFailureOSB is a reversible implementation diagnostic; it does not establish physical fracture qualification.
Point clouds and curves show only values present in the verified native arrays; no crack surface or fracture geometry is synthesized.
A passing arithmetic audit does not establish calibrated material physics or general solver validity.
